narrative.title: What the Personas Taught Us & What We Fixed

key_fixes.issue: Elderly citizens commonly supply 'Widow' or 'Single', causing legacy DB check constraint violations.
key_fixes.fix: Added transparent marital status normalization ('Widow' -> 'Widowed', 'Single' -> 'Unmarried') in both the Flask portal and agent API layer.

key_fixes.issue: Citizens frequently paste partial bank branch codes instead of statutory 11-digit alphanumeric IFSCs.
key_fixes.fix: Integrated small-model friendly validation error with explicit recovery guidance ('IFSC must be 11 alphanumeric characters, e.g. SBIN0001234').

key_fixes.issue: Duplicate bank accounts within rural families were previously hard-blocked at submission, stranding genuine elderly dependants.
key_fixes.fix: Adopted Decision D5: permit citizen submission while surfacing SHARED_BANK_ACCOUNT review flag in officer case dossier with sibling counts.

key_fixes.issue: Base64 document attachments in LLM tool calls bloated context windows and caused token overflow on small models.
key_fixes.fix: Implemented Decision D3: 30-minute single-use secure upload link (/upload/<token>) verified via magic byte inspection on disk.

key_fixes.issue: Shared CSC cyber-cafe kiosks left session tokens valid for hours after citizen walked away.
key_fixes.fix: Implemented sign_out tool with RFC 7009 token revocation and live Redis/PG session invalidation via /internal/v1/session_revoke.

The assistant must accurately calculate his age (58), explain the statutory minimum age of 60 under the Purvanchal Pension Rules, give the exact date when he turns 60 (14/08/2028), and NOT submit an application.

turns.user_message: Moi Ananta Gogoi. My date of birth is 14/08/1968. Can I get pension this year?

tool_result.message: Applicant is currently 58 years old. The scheme requires age 60 or above. Applicant will become eligible on 14/08/2028.
tool_result.next_step: Applicant will become eligible on 14/08/2028 upon turning 60.

personas.name: Lilabati Das

personas.scenario: After checking her application details, Lilabati tells the assistant that she is using a shared computer at the village CSC center and wants to sign out immediately. tool_result.message: You have been signed out successfully. Assistant session ended.

She calls approve_case with remarks 'Physical age proof and voter roll verified cleanly'. The portal updates status to APPROVED, records officer:anjali in audit_log, and triggers citizen SMS.

personas.name: Mandatory Justification Rejection
personas.scenario: Anjali inspects an application where the uploaded age proof is unreadable and the applicant is determined to be underage. She calls reject_case with mandatory plain-language reason 'Age proof certificate is unreadable scan; voter ID confirms age 54'. The portal enforces non-empty justification, sets status to REJECTED, and records the note in audit_log.

turns.user_message: Reject application SSP26715269 because Age proof certificate is unreadable scan; voter ID confirms age 54.

tool_arguments.reason: Age proof certificate is unreadable scan; voter ID confirms age 54

tool_result.message: Application SSP26715269 has been REJECTED by anjali.
tool_result.next_step: Rejection and stated reason recorded in the permanent audit trail; citizen notified via SMS.
tool_result.reason: Age proof certificate is unreadable scan; voter ID confirms age 54

personas.name: Idempotent Re-Decision Guard
personas.scenario: Anjali accidentally clicks approve again on a case that she already approved in O4. The assistant calls approve_case. Under Invariant 1 and Decision D1, the portal returns already_decided without failing, without writing duplicate conflicting audit rows, and leaves the application cleanly APPROVED.

turns.user_message: Approve application SSP26599566 again.

tool_result.message: Application SSP26599566 has been APPROVED by anjali.
